title: The coord hook's intents carry the operator id, and kbmon's sessions panel shows who runs each session
goal: the coord hook's SessionStart and claim intents carry the field operator with the session's operator id from kbwho.operator(), which a coord server's own operator field still replaces; kbmon.py --status sessions names this clone's operator id and the operator of each live session intent, never an email address

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, json, re
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
C = os.path.join(T, "clone")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copytree(".claude/hooks", os.path.join(C, ".claude", "hooks"))
for f in ("backlog.json", ".gitignore"):
    shutil.copy(f, C)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
shutil.copy("kb/_self/map.csv", os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "map.csv"))
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.makedirs(B)
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"  # built at run time: no address sits in the check's text
def stub(body):
    p = os.path.join(B, "claude"); open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\n" + body + "\n"); os.chmod(p, 0o755)
stub("echo '{\"loggedIn\": true, \"authMethod\": \"claude.ai\", \"email\": \"%s\"}'" % EM)
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(PATH=os.pathsep.join([B, os.path.dirname(shutil.which("git")), "/usr/bin", "/bin"]), HOME=T,
           GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def run(tool, *a, stdin=None, **kw):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, *tool.split("/")) if "/" in tool else os.path.join(C, "_tools", tool), *a],
                          cwd=C, env={**ENV, **kw}, input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
O = dict(KB_OPERATOR="op-test0001", KB_ROLE="orchestrator")
g("checkout", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa")
pay = json.dumps({"hook_event_name": "SessionStart", "session_id": "s-planted-1", "cwd": C, "source": "startup"})
r = run(".claude/hooks/coord_hook.py", stdin=pay, **O)
r = run("coord.py", "wait", "--since", "0", "--timeout", "1", **O)
ev = [e for e in json.loads(r.stdout or "{}").get("events", []) if e.get("kind") == "intent"]
assert ev, ("the SessionStart hook posted no intent", r.stdout[-300:], r.stderr[-300:])
assert all((e.get("fields") or {}).get("operator") == "op-test0001" for e in ev), ("the hook's intent does not carry the operator id", ev)
r = run("kbmon.py", "--status", "sessions", **O)
assert r.returncode == 0 and "op-test0001" in r.stdout, ("kbmon's sessions panel does not show the operator id", r.returncode, r.stdout[-500:], r.stderr[-300:])
assert EM not in r.stdout, "kbmon's sessions panel shows the email"
